lines.text: Hello, friends! I am Milo the bluebird.
Today we are playing Yes or No!
I will ask a question about an animal friend.
If you think yes, give a thumbs up. If you think no, shake your head.
Let's practice. Yes or no. Am I a bluebird?
Yes! I am Milo the bluebird! Good job.
Are you ready? Let's play!
Here is the polar bear. Look at that white, fluffy fur.
Yes or no. Is a polar bear's skin white?
No! Here is the fun fact. Under the fur, a polar bear's skin is black!
Look closer. Black skin, hiding under all that fur.
And the fur is not really white. Each hair is clear, like glass!
The black skin soaks up the warm sunshine. It helps the polar bear stay cozy in the cold.
Say it with me. Polar bear skin is black!
Can you shiver like you are in the snow? Brrr, brrr, brrr!
Brilliant!
Here is the horse. Clip, clop!
Yes or no. Can a horse sleep standing up?
Yes! Here is the fun fact. A horse can sleep standing up!
Its legs lock in place, so it does not fall over.
For a big, deep sleep, the horse lies down on the soft ground.
A horse does not sleep all night like you. It takes lots of tiny naps!
Standing up, the horse is always ready to trot away with its friends.
Say it with me. Horses can sleep standing up!
Can you stand very still and close your eyes? Shh. One, two, three.
Wake up! Good job!
Here is the elephant. So big and strong!
Yes or no. Can an elephant jump?
No! Here is the fun fact. Elephants cannot jump!
An elephant is too big and heavy. It always keeps a foot on the ground.
A frog can jump. A bunny can jump. And you can jump. But an elephant? No!
But elephants can walk fast, and they are great swimmers!
Say it with me. Elephants cannot jump!
Can you jump? Elephants can't, but you can! Jump, jump, jump!
What great jumping!
Here is the giraffe. Look at that long, long neck!
Yes or no. Does a giraffe have the same number of neck bones as you?
Yes! Here is the fun fact. A giraffe has seven neck bones. And so do you!
The giraffe's neck bones are just much, much bigger. Each one is as long as a ruler!
Let's count them. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven!
A tiny mouse has seven neck bones too. Almost every furry animal has seven!
Say it with me. Seven neck bones, just like me!
Can you touch your neck? Gently now. Nod your head. Yes, yes, yes!
Super nodding!
Wow! What a great game. Let's play one more time, super fast!
Get ready!
Is a polar bear's skin white?
No! It is black!
Can a horse sleep standing up?
Yes! It can!
Can an elephant jump?
No! Elephants cannot jump!
Does a giraffe have seven neck bones, like you?
Yes! Seven, just like you!
You learned four new things today.
Shiver like a polar bear. Stand still like a horse. Jump, because elephants can't! And nod like a giraffe!
Which answer surprised you the most?
One last question. Yes or no. Did you have fun today?
Yes! Me too!
Thank you for playing with me. Bye-bye, friends! See you next time!
